latest_release.name: v0.3.4
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: Add interactive browser playground & guided tutorial by @pranshuparmar in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/212
* feat: Landing polish: README fixes, contributor docs cleanup, mode-aware playground Reset by @pranshuparmar in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/213
* feat: Add anonymous analytics via GoatCounter by @pranshuparmar in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/214
* docs: Add llms.txt for LLM/agent-readable project summary by @abyworkings-coder in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/217
* fix(install): create the bin directory before installing the binary by @Sharma-IT in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/221
* feat: add Apple container runtime support by @OVELYB in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/211
* fix(darwin): force LC_ALL=C for locale-sensitive ps invocations by @shuvamk in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/218
* fix(windows): normalize localized listener states by @NgoQuocViet2001 in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/231
* feat: support the LoongArch (loong64) architecture by @xuxiaowei-com-cn in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/234
* fix(tui): honor CLI targets when launching interactive mode by @chiliec in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/238
* fix(output): keep colors on terminals without bright ANSI support by @CJstate in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/239
* fix(proc): stop ancestry at recycled parent PIDs by @aoright in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/226
* fix(build): replace the symlinked root main.go with a real entry point by @CJstate in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/242
* feat: v0.3.4 Main PR by @pranshuparmar in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/243

## New Contributors
* @abyworkings-coder made their first contribution in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/217
* @Sharma-IT made their first contribution in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/221

* @NgoQuocViet2001 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/231
* @xuxiaowei-com-cn made their first contribution in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/234
* @chiliec made their first contribution in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/238
* @CJstate made their first contribution in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/239
* @aoright made their first contribution in https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/pull/226

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pranshuparmar/witr/compare/v0.3.3...v0.3.4
